svg.title: HyperOx mobile: Sign in
svg.text: M0.2a · design pass I · phone 360×800 dp · tablet 840×900 dp · light = paper · dark = darkmatter

g.text: Live terminals and agents on every
SSH only · no relay, no push
Glass card over the falling-code band and dot-matrix mark
(desktop sign-in language). Google is primary; GitHub and
email secondary. "Continue without an account" leads to Add
machine › SSH with no account and no relay. Focus starts on
Live terminals and agents on every
SSH only · no relay, no push
Same layout in darkmatter. The accent (#e78a53) tints the
mark, wash and solid button, as on the desktop sign-in.
Live terminals and agents on every machine
Needs-you alerts with Approve and Deny.
Use the same HyperOx account as your
desktop. Your machines show up on their own.
SSH only · no relay, no push
Without an account, add machines by host, IP or
Tailscale name. You can sign in later in Settings.
Width ≥ 600 dp: bento left (mark + three benefits), sign-in right. Code band fades in at the bottom only. Same order for focus: left tiles are not
focusable; focus starts on Continue with Google.
Live terminals and agents on every
SSH only · no relay, no push
The pressed provider becomes a status row with a spinner
and Cancel; the others disable (38 %). Screen reader
SSH only · no relay, no push
Error banner takes the tagline slot, right above the buttons,
so retry is one tap on the same provider. Message says what
happened and that nothing was saved. Announced as an alert.
Account sign-in needs internet. SSH to
machines on this network still works.
SSH only · no relay, no push
Account providers disable; the SSH-only path stays live
because LAN / Tailscale may still work. Banner explains why
Use the email of your HyperOx account. New
here? The same step creates one.
We send a sign-in link. It opens this app.
Signing in on pavii.tech works too:
Email sign-in sends a link (Firebase email link) that opens the
app; pavii.tech login is the fallback. Field and primary button
Unlock is asked after 5 minutes away. Change it
After the first sign-in the app asks for the fingerprint / face
(local_auth) when opened after 5 min. PIN fallback; Sign out
At 2.0× text the logo shrinks, buttons grow to 108 dp and
wrap labels, and the screen scrolls. Nothing truncates; the
